{{Quote|I am Ensign Llona. I'm here to help you get acquainted with the ''Devastator''.|Llona identifies herself to Kell Bircher|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
'''Llona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was stationed on board the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] where she was assigned to assist [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kell Bircher]] when command of the ship was transferred to him from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Bircher however was already well acquainted with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and deemed her help unneeded in that area, instead reassigning her to serve him on a permanent basis. Her first assignment from Bircher was to learn if Darth Vader had left the ''Devastator'' or not.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Llona first appeared in the [[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]] of the comic book series simply titled "[[Star Wars (2013)|''Star Wars'']]" published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Brian Wood]], illustrated by [[Carlos D'Anda]] and colored by [[Gabe Eltaeb]]. It was released on [[February]] [[February 13|13]] [[2013]].
